significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling: the purported truth direction tracks "whether a statement is presented/endorsed as true" across truth-preserving and endorsement-preserving dissociations, predicting high scores for "confidently asserted falsehoods" and lower scores for true hearsay; the steering component additionally proposes a form-(ii) causal effect on assertion rather than factual reasoning. This would establish both a behavioral phenomenon and a mechanistic reinterpretation of the latent directions used by CCS (Burns et al., 2022), Geometry of Truth (Marks and Tegmark, 2023), ITI (Li et al., 2023), and Azaria and Mitchell (2023), constraining when those directions can support factuality explanations or audits. Verified false would still rule out endorsement as the primary general explanation, although it would not by itself distinguish genuine world-truth encoding from mixed or method-specific representations; true and false therefore identify distinct, informative states of the world. In the topic-substitution check, merely restating "research on LLM beliefs" would not justify this score: the extra weight comes specifically from the claimed truth-versus-endorsement ordering and its consequences across several established probe interpretations.

reach.justification: The named handle is a reinterpreted "monitor of endorsement," together with a steering direction that changes "assertion behavior rather than its factual reasoning"; it could warn auditors that a high truth-probe score does not detect confident falsehoods. The diagnostic is principally post hoc or contemporaneous rather than an explicitly ex-ante forecast, but the claimed relation survives recalibration: after extracting a direction on another model, it predicts the same ordering among asserted falsehoods, true hearsay, and embedded beliefs rather than merely supplying an open-ended search procedure. The hypothesis presents the account as applying to the "widely-studied linear 'truth direction' in LLMs" and across CCS, mass-mean, and supervised probes, so downstream users include interpretability researchers and practitioners using activation probes to audit or steer model outputs, though cross-architecture and cross-scale scope is not stated sharply. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this reach score: generic LLM-belief research supplies neither the endorsement monitor nor the concrete deployment warning that truth probes "fail to catch confident falsehoods."
